## How it was checked

- [ ] `npm test` passes, with Ghostscript installed (`gs --version`: ...)
- [ ] A new behaviour has a test, and a fixed bug has a test that failed before the fix
- [ ] If the output changes: the README, `docs/` and `CHANGELOG.md` say so, and the example PDFs are rebuilt with `npm run example`
- [ ] No new dependency, or the reason for one is given below
